import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
from io import StringIO

# Create the dataset
data = """brand,model_year,megapixels,max_iso,weight_grams,price_usd,sensor_type,has_video_4k,lens_mount,body_type
Leica,2005,13.5,25600,324,811.8,Micro 4/3,1,E,Compact
Fuji,2019,46.4,51200,1151,3596.41,APS-C,0,EF,Mirrorless
Pentax,2012,38.7,12800,598,3357.2,Full Frame,0,MFT,Mirrorless
Olympus,2015,22.5,6400,1095,1555.7,APS-C,0,Z,Mirrorless
Leica,2016,12.2,25600,290,3899.09,Medium Format,0,MFT,DSLR"""

df = pd.read_csv(StringIO(data))

# Set up the figure with multiple subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(14, 10))
fig.suptitle('Camera Dataset Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# Color palette for brands
brand_colors = {'Leica': '#E41A1C', 'Fuji': '#377EB8', 'Pentax': '#4DAF4A', 'Olympus': '#984EA3'}

# 1. Scatter plot: Megapixels vs Price by Brand
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(2, 2, 1)
for brand in df['brand'].unique():
    brand_data = df[df['brand'] == brand]
    ax1.scatter(brand_data['megapixels'], brand_data['price_usd'], 
                s=brand_data['weight_grams']/5, label=brand, 
                color=brand_colors[brand], alpha=0.7, edgecolors='black')
ax1.set_xlabel('Megapixels', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_ylabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_title('Megapixels vs Price\n(bubble size = weight)', fontsize=11)
ax1.legend(title='Brand', loc='upper left')
ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# 2. Bar chart: Price by Brand
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(2, 2, 2)
brand_prices = df.groupby('brand')['price_usd'].mean().sort_values(ascending=True)
bars = ax2.barh(brand_prices.index, brand_prices.values, 
                color=[brand_colors[b] for b in brand_prices.index], edgecolor='black')
ax2.set_xlabel('Price (USD)', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_title('Average Price by Brand', fontsize=11)
for bar, price in zip(bars, brand_prices.values):
    ax2.text(price + 50, bar.get_y() + bar.get_height()/2, f'${price:,.0f}', 
             va='center', fontsize=9)
ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.3, axis='x')

# 3. Pie chart: Sensor Type Distribution
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(2, 2, 3)
sensor_counts = df['sensor_type'].value_counts()
colors_pie = plt.cm.Set3(range(len(sensor_counts)))
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax3.pie(sensor_counts.values, labels=sensor_counts.index, 
                                    autopct='%1.0f%%', colors=colors_pie,
                                    explode=[0.05]*len(sensor_counts), startangle=90)
ax3.set_title('Sensor Type Distribution', fontsize=11)

# 4. Timeline: Model Year vs Max ISO with annotations
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(2, 2, 4)
for brand in df['brand'].unique():
    brand_data = df[df['brand'] == brand]
    ax4.scatter(brand_data['model_year'], brand_data['max_iso'], 
                s=100, label=brand, color=brand_colors[brand], 
                marker='o', edgecolors='black', zorder=3)
    for _, row in brand_data.iterrows():
        ax4.annotate(f"{row['megapixels']}MP", 
                    (row['model_year'], row['max_iso']),
                    xytext=(5, 5), textcoords='offset points', fontsize=8)

ax4.set_xlabel('Model Year', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_ylabel('Max ISO', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_title('Max ISO by Model Year\n(annotated with megapixels)', fontsize=11)
ax4.legend(title='Brand', loc='upper left')
ax4.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
ax4.set_yscale('log')

plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=150, bbox_inches='tight', facecolor='white')
plt.close()
